display.purpose: Page h1: greeting, resume name, blog and post titles.

headline.purpose: Section h2 separated by hairline rules.

meta.purpose: Dates and contact lines in quiet ink.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Link underline, color, and button background transitions (200-250ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action per row, e.g. Email me.
components.html: Email me
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; padding: .8rem 1.15rem; border-radius: .5rem; border: 1px solid #1f6f5c; background: #1f6f5c; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn svg { width: 1.05em; height: 1.05em; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #155244; border-color: #155244; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6f5c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action such as Save as PDF.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; padding: .8rem 1.15rem; border-radius: .5rem; border: 1px solid #e2e6e3; background: transparent; color: #1d2220; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #6c7571; background: #eef3f0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6f5c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Green link with a faint underline that solidifies on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #1f6f5c; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .22em; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, #1f6f5c 40%, transparent); transition: text-decoration-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-link:hover { color: #155244; text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6f5c; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Name left, two links right; current page gets a 2px green underline.
components.html:
Enrinal
ResumeBlog
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; color: #1d2220; } .ds-name { font-weight: 650; color: #1d2220; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -.005em; } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; } .ds-nav nav a { color: #4e5753; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav nav a:hover { color: #1d2220; } .ds-nav nav a[aria-current] { color: #1d2220; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #1f6f5c; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: .45em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6f5c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Availability Line
components.description: Status dot with a single sentence; not a badge.
components.html: Open to senior backend roles, remote or with relocation.
components.css: .ds-open { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin: 0; color: #1d2220; font-weight: 550; } .ds-open i { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #1f6f5c; flex: none; }

components.name: Dated Row
components.description: Date column, title, one-line description, hairline below.
components.html:
2021–2024

Senior Engineer Company

One line on what was owned.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .1rem 1.25rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e6e3; color: #1d2220; } .ds-when { color: #6c7571; font-size: .95rem; padding-top: .1rem; } .ds-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-row h3 span { color: #4e5753; font-weight: 400; } .ds-row h3 span::before { content: "· "; } .ds-row p { margin: .3rem 0 0; color: #4e5753; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Headline above a hairline rule; the only section divider.
components.css: .ds-section { margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 2.25rem; border-top: 1px solid #e2e6e3; } .ds-section h2 { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.015em; line-height: 1.25; color: #1d2220; }

narrative.overview:
One left-aligned reading column (40rem) on a cool near-white ground, set entirely in Hanken Grotesk. The visitor meets a person first and the structure second. Sections are separated by hairline rules and generous space, never by boxes, cards, or pills. A single deep green carries every link and the one filled action per view; dark mode mirrors the same roles with a lifted mint green.

Hierarchy comes from size and weight steps only. Motion is limited to underline and color transitions on one soft ease-out (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), 200-250ms). Resume page must print to a clean one-column A4 PDF, so every screen rule has a monochrome print fallback.
keyCharacteristics: One column, one typeface, one accent.
Hairline rules and whitespace instead of containers.
Weight and size steps (400, 550, 600, 650, 700) in place of display faces.
Light and dark are the same system with mirrored roles.
Print is a first-class output: nav, footer, and buttons drop; accent becomes black.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green appears only on interactive or status elements (links, the primary button, the availability dot, focus, selection). Never as a section fill or decorative accent.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Every light token has a dark twin under the same custom-property name; new surfaces use the property, never a literal.

rules.name: The Steps-Not-Faces Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a size or weight step within Hanken Grotesk; never a second family or case styling.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Text lives in the 40rem column; contact paragraph caps at 34rem.

dos: Do separate sections with a 1px `rule` and spacing, not containers.
Do reference custom properties (`--fg`, `--accent`, `--rule`) so dark mode and print follow.
Do keep one filled button per action row and use text links for the rest.
Do give every new screen rule a print fallback if it can appear on the resume.
donts: Don't add cards, skill pills, photo hero, or box shadows; the build uses none.
Don't introduce a second typeface or all-caps labels.
Don't use green for decoration, backgrounds, or non-interactive text.
Don't animate beyond color and underline transitions.
